title: fix(core): synthesize AxiosError message from AggregateError.errors
label: docs-relevant
label_corrected: 2026-07-19 (M2). Originally labeled not-relevant in M1. Corrected: the diff edits PRE_RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md, and four sibling entries in this same corpus (axios#11081, axios#11071, zod#5929, got#2466) treat 'the maintainers updated docs/changelog in this same PR' as decisive evidence of docs-relevance. The original label contradicted the corpus's own stated methodology. Correction is grounded in that methodology and the diff contents, NOT in the classifier's disagreement — see corpus/README.md 'Post-M1 label corrections'.
rationale: AxiosError.from() now synthesizes a .message from AggregateError.errors instead of leaving it blank, and toJSON() carries it. The PR updates PRE_RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md in the same diff, confirming the maintainers consider this a user-facing change worth describing.
